description: This file defines a generic Memo class used for caching calculation results with dependency tracking, including methods for dependency change detection and hash code calculation.

classes.name: Memo
classes.description: A generic class implementing a memoization cache with dependency change detection for calculations.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the cached value, recomputing if dependencies have changed.

methods.name: checkDependencyChangedAndUpdate
methods.description: Checks if dependencies have changed and updates the dependency hash codes accordingly.

methods.name: getHashCode
methods.description: Calculates hash code for a dependency, using reference equality if specified.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory methods to create Memo instances with different dependency configurations.
